title: Remove caffeine.ai attribution from public footer

requirements.summary: Remove the “Built with”/heart/“using”/caffeine.ai attribution elements from the public footer while keeping the rest unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: The footer no longer shows the text “Built with”.
The heart icon no longer appears in the footer.
The footer no longer shows the text “using”.
The “caffeine.ai” link is removed and no longer appears in the DOM.
The disclaimer section remains present and unchanged.

file_operations.description: Remove the “Built with” span, the Heart icon, the “using” span, and the external caffeine.ai link so they no longer render; keep the disclaimer block and existing footer layout/styling unchanged. Also remove any now-unused imports related to the removed elements.
